catalogue.note: A node-for-node copy of the modular fund screen: the two Figma renders differ by 3 antialiased pixels and every asset matches after normalising, so the build is regenerated from it with this frame’s node ids. The hidden Group 181 and the hidden “selected” groups on cards two and three are not built. The Risk acceptance checkbox is check/checked; the frame-level response showed it unchecked. The title, the 28px header, the 10px labels and the tooltip’s “i” move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value.
